description: Select an XML element in the Structure pane, or select its content in the layout (Go to Item); select the element of a tagged frame (Select in Structure); or move through the Structure pane with its navigation commands (expand, collapse, next validation error and so on)

element.description: An XML element: its id (from list_xml_structure), its path of child indexes from the root element ([] is the root), the first element an XPath expression matches, or selection: true for the element selected in the Structure pane (or the selected tagged item). Give exactly one

path.description: Child indexes from the root, e.g. [0, 2] is the third child of the root's first child

selection.description: Use the element selected in the Structure pane

xpath.description: XPath expression evaluated from the root element, e.g. //article[@id="a1"]

itemId.description: Or: a tagged page item whose element to select (Select in Structure)

paneCommand.description: A Structure pane navigation command, run after any selection (the pane must be open)

repeat.description: Run the navigation command this many times

show.description: structure selects the element in the Structure pane; layout selects its frame or text and shows its page (Go to Item)

name: select_xml_element
title: Select XML Element
